precipitation.uncertainty_source: IMERG V07 documented uncertainty over land at monthly to annual scales, as knowledge/datasets/imerg-v07.md records it

coverage.mean: cosine-latitude weighted over cells whose centre is inside the polygon
coverage.volume: basin-mean depth times the polygon's equal-area area from its provenance

evapotranspiration.uncertainty_source: MOD16 validation against flux towers and watersheds, as knowledge/datasets/mod16a2gf.md records it
evapotranspiration.open_water: cells the product marks as water (32766) are excluded from the mean: MOD16 computes no open-water evaporation, so this basin mean is land evapotranspiration and any reservoir evaporation has to be added from another source

discharge.uncertainty_source: USGS rating class good, plus or minus 5 per cent of the daily value, from the station description; a poorer class widens this and the receipt says which

storage.reason: the basin is 3,767 km2, below the footprint floor of 111,266 km2 (one mostly-land mascon, derived from the product's own geometry): it spans 1 mascon(s), so the mascon field carries no signal that is this basin's rather than its neighbourhood's. No storage term exists, the residual is not reported, and a gain factor is not applied to rescue it
